text: Recite the ashtottara shatanamavali of Sri Mahishasuramardini and perform kumkuma puja.
If you have an idol, offer a little kumkuma on the idol with each name.
If you have the Devi's picture or a kalasham, place a small bowl in front of it and offer the kumkuma into it.
When the 108 names are done, bow to the Devi.
